entries.back_en: "Well then! I was waiting for you."
"Well then! I was waiting for you."
"You...! What did you do with Elina!?"
"Ah, Captain. I fear you've missed him. The General left for the capital."
"I fear the General and others like him could not understand what I intend to do..."
"I don't care about the General or what he thinks!! What did you mean when you said Elina isn't here!?"
"You came...As I had prayed..."
"Elina! You don't know how glad I am to see you!"
"Thank you for coming for me...But..."
"I fear I cannot leave here..."
"Why not!? The capital was attacked--the Empire is distracted! We could flee before they noticed!"
"She's right. Let's go, Elina. I'll protect you--I swear!"
"The world is changing...I feel it...And you and the rest...You're all caught up in the path causing that change. You're part of it."
"You must continue your journey...You are needed in a specific place, at an exact moment...You must be there!"
"Could you leave us alone for a moment?"
"Wait a moment...How did Elina know your name?"
"I already told you how you're part of the great change that's coming...How you're caught in a powerful stream carrying you."
"One of the streams that moves the world is..."
"When these two streams find, then you shall learn the true meaning of your journey."
"What do you mean, Elina? How can you know these things? And why can't you leave here?"
"...It's because...Because I'm..."
"Transformed...? What are you talking about!?"
"A sacrifice!?"
"...And so, Elina became engaged to the Prince of Ludia. Of course, if you had stopped them, by now..."
entries.note: 'Certo' for 'Of course' slightly casual but acceptable.

entries.back_en: "...And so, Elina became engaged to the Prince of Ludia. Of course, if you had stopped them, by now..."
"NO!"
"You...You...Maniac! Monster! I'll kill with my own hands!!"
entries.note: Missing object 'te/você'; should be 'Vou te matar'.

entries.back_en: "You would kill...me!? Me...who can create gods! You cannot kill me!"
"I have a destiny! I shall use my knowledge to transform the world!"
"It's...It's too late for me."
"Elina...I...I'm sorry...If only I'd arrived sooner...I..."
"I don't want to live forever like this. Please...Don't let me suffer any more."
"I...I can't do it! Elina...I...I love you, Elina!"
"I know. That's why I'm asking you. You're the only one I can ask to do this."
"I'm happy knowing your face is the last I'll see."
